name: Indirect Illumination Modeling via Baking
definition: A precomputation technique to model indirect illumination and occlusion by caching occlusion information into Spherical Harmonics (SH) coefficients stored in 3D volumes, enabling efficient online calculation.
summary: Indirect Illumination Modeling via Baking precomputes occlusion into Spherical Harmonics coefficients within 3D volumes to approximate indirect lighting in 3D Gaussian Splatting, distinguishing itself by explicitly baking geometric occlusion into these coefficients.
